k164 在遊戲中只有 v0–v2，final_b 的 v3、v4 格顯示「缺」是既有狀態，不是本批造成

kinds.name: 高壓輸電變電站
variants: v0 Outdoor air-insulated substation (AIS): a double-circuit lattice terminal tower feeds a lattice line gantry. Two line bays each run CVT with line trap, disconnector, live-tank breaker, then CT. They connect to a 3-phase tubular busbar, then transformer-bay breakers, two main transformers (radiators, conservator, porcelain bushings) with a firewall between them. Control room at right, road along the front.

v1 Indoor gas-insulated substation (GIS): a large metal-clad hall (vertical ribs, clerestory window band, roller doors, louvres, roof vents) with three SF6 bushings on the roof wired to a terminal tower at right-back. Two outdoor transformers with a firewall sit in front of the hall, joined to it by bus ducts. Office/control annex with windows, canopy and AC units at right-front.

v2 Extra-high-voltage switchyard: two rows of tall lattice gantries (the back one has hanging line traps) with dead-tank breakers, disconnectors, CTs and surge arresters in bays between them. At the front: a three-tier capacitor bank inside its own inner fence, and a greenish shunt reactor with a firewall. Small relay kiosk at right-back, road down the right side.

v3 Old 1960s substation: weathered lattice rack structure with suspended strings and vertical-break switches on top, two three-tank oil breakers, two olive-colored older transformers, a red-brick control house with a pitched roof, wooden feeder poles with crossarms at the front, a sand-bucket rack, and weeds in the gravel.

v4 Extra-high-voltage single-phase transformer bank: two tall terminal towers, a high gantry, a row of CVTs and surge arresters, three single-phase units (one tall bushing each) separated by high firewalls, transformer rails with sleepers, a red deluge water tank and pump house at right-back, and a two-storey control building at left.
kinds.notes: All five keys 148_1_0 to 148_1_4 are overwritten (canvas 136x150, anchor 68,148 unchanged); the five layouts differ in structure. Only thin steel, insulators and conductors are drawn without an outline, using two-tone pixels, so they don't turn into heavy black lines; solid equipment and buildings keep the outline. Night lights come only from windows, pole lamps, transformer warning lights and tower aviation lights, and a light hidden behind a nearer object is erased. Ground shadows are clipped to the ground diamond, and a border scan shows nothing touches the canvas edge. Weak points, stated plainly: (1) The bay equipment in v0 and v2 is still dense, reading as a gray-white mass at 1x; the gear shapes only separate at 2x. (2) In v3 the oil breakers and old transformers overlap in front of the rack, so the middle of the image is fairly busy. (3) In v1 the GIS hall's roller doors and bus ducts are mostly hidden by the transformers. (4) The conductors from the towers are 1px curves and look a little messy in places.

kinds.name: 電網調度中心
variants: v0 Modern dispatch building: a five-storey curtain-wall office tower (lobby, rooftop plant room, microwave lattice mast with dish antennas) plus a large-glass control hall showing the blue-green video wall inside, with chillers and a satellite dish on its roof. Container gensets and a fuel tank at the back. Parking lot with cars in front, guardhouse with boom barrier, three flagpoles, trees, palisade fence.

v1 Hardened dispatch center: a concrete block with narrow ribbon windows, a glass control-room band on the top floor (screen light visible), a blast-resistant entrance portal and anti-ram bollards. Freestanding self-supporting telecom tower with several dishes and an equipment shelter at right-back. Two large ground satellite dishes at front-left. Two gensets side by side, a vertical fuel tank, a parking lot and a guardhouse.

v2 Two-building campus: a seven-storey curtain-wall tower (vertical aluminum fins, setback crown, rooftop monopole with panel antennas) linked by a skybridge to a barrel-roofed control hall with a big glass wall showing the video wall. Two square cooling towers at right-back, parking at front-left, landscaped pond at front-right, flagpole and guardhouse.

v3 1980s dispatch office: a four-storey tiled building with ribbon windows and a separate stair tower. On the roof: a lattice microwave tower with horn and dish antennas, a water tank on legs, and AC units. A single-storey control annex with punched windows, window AC units and a small dish. An auxiliary substation yard (transformer, wooden pole, fence) at right-back. Mature trees, a small parking area and a flagpole.

v4 Green-building dispatch center: a glass block with sunshade louvres, a green roof and rooftop solar panels, plus a cylindrical glass control room (video wall and lights visible inside). Monopole telecom tower, battery storage container and genset at right-back. Open parking with EV chargers plus a row of solar carports, a rain garden, a guardhouse and trees.
kinds.notes: All five keys 149_1_0 to 149_1_4 are overwritten (canvas 208x220, anchor 104,218 unchanged). The ground is a lawn with asphalt and paving instead of gravel, and the perimeter is a new concrete-base palisade with gate pillars rather than the substation chain-link fence. Night lights: office windows lit per floor and bay by deterministic hash; the control-room video walls glow blue-green; guardhouse, lamp poles, aviation lights, genset status LEDs and EV charger lights also glow. Water surfaces do not light up. Weak points: (1) Cars are only a few pixels and read as small colored blobs at 1x. (2) The v2 skybridge is almost fully hidden by the tower and control hall. (3) In v4, the video wall inside the cylindrical control room shows only as a small patch, and the battery container is partly hidden by the genset. (4) The v1 top-floor glass band and the v3 ribbon windows look alike at 1x, so the two buildings are told apart mainly by material color and the rooftop antennas.

problems: No blockers. The file passes node --check, and the batch function and each variant have their own try/catch. It uses no Math.random, ri(), plate() or speck(); the local pixel helper named R was renamed RC to avoid confusion with the game's R(), and a re-render is pixel-identical to the output before the rename.
The final sheet holds both classes on one image (148 and 149 together, which is within the two-class limit), so there is no _b sheet.
The intermediate renders infra_a2_before and infra_a2_iter1 to iter8 (.png/.json) are still in shots575; delete them if not needed.
A copy of the final sheet from before the rename (infra_a2_prev.png) was left in the %TEMP% folder for the pixel comparison and was not deleted.

k163 在表上的 v3/v4 顯示「缺」：這一類依規格只有 v0–v2 三個鍵，和舊版現況相同，不是這次造成的。

kinds.notes: 下凹池體用高度場，逐條斜列排進場景排序，前緣土堤會正確遮住池底和池內結構。坡面依法線打光（+v 亮、+u 暗），坡度夠陡就判定為擋土牆並改用混凝土色。改過：土舌式頭牆原本像巨大水泥楔形，改成坡腳的矮頭牆；斜向坡道會鋸齒化成階梯，改成軸向坡道；v4 前池太窄，重新配置；v4 進流管原本在常水位以下，已抬高。另外發現並修掉一個雜湊相關性問題：hsh(seed,i,j) 內部做 i^j，會拉出條紋。五個變體都是 fence:false（公園型，不畫前圍籬）。還沒做好的地方：(1) 等距視角下前側坡面本來就看不到，靠前緣的池底一部分被遮住；(2) v0 低水路加寬後仍有些微鋸齒；(3) v3 樹穴縮小後看起來像棕色小叉；(4) v4 主池在一般縮放下仍偏素；(5) 夜間只有路燈、照明塔、涼亭燈和售亭窗會亮，水面不發光，所以 v0、v4 夜圖比較暗。

kinds.notes: 植物用「量體」畫法：頂面依 2×2 區塊調色，偶爾點上穗色；側面有直立莖稈紋，高度以 0.2u 叢塊為單位起伏，避免逐像素變成雜點牆。改過：逐角點高度抖動和逐像素高光造成的十字雜點；睡蓮花因雜湊相關連成粉紅條紋；v2 種植行距和 1/16 高度場網格混疊，床面一半變成抬高的礫石（行距改成對齊 4 格）；草甸野花因 i^j 雜湊拉成直條（已修，並降低密度）。還沒做好的地方：(1) 一般縮放下，v0 各格的物種差異主要靠色調，蘆葦和香蒲不容易分辨；(2) v1 自然式是這三類裡最碎、最忙的，已經簡化過，但水域和植物帶邊界還是比較破碎；(3) v0–v3 夜間光源很少（只有路燈、LED、教育館窗），依「先有燈具才有光」規則，夜圖偏暗；(4) 只有 v2 是 fence:true，其他是公園型、不畫前圍籬。

reviews.overall: 三批都完成了所有變體鍵（148–160 各五個、161–164 各三個），全部從平視長方形改成等距真實場站，風格、光向和描邊與新 BESS 一致，夜圖也只亮白天畫出的燈具和窗。多格類（148、149、150、151、152、164）整體水準高，結構差異明顯。要退回修改的是三處讀不懂或像雜線的地方：k161 v1 磚房讀不出是變電所；k163 v2 灌木是空心圈、v0 艙口讀不出是打開的；k151 v4 手輪看起來浮空，v2 明渠被閘墩擋住。三批都還沒放進 1 倍的實際城市截圖驗證密度，建議改完後以 1×1 小站（161、162、163、155）為重點補一張城市實景圖。

verdicts.issues: 整體通過：五個變體都一眼認得出是淨水廠，結構也各不相同（傳統矩形池、圓形澄清池、紅磚慢濾池、平板沉澱加活性碳槽、鋸齒屋頂加蓋），風格和 BESS 一致。只剩一個手藝問題要修：v2 覆土清水池上的磚造通氣小亭，底部畫在 z=0，沒有墊到池頂高度，看起來往前挪了約 3px，像浮在池邊。要把小亭的 box 底高設成池頂高度，並排在池頂之後畫。順手可以改（不擋定稿）：v4 夜間鋸齒屋頂的採光窗亮度降一半，或只點亮其中一半窗格；v3 那排 5 座藍色壓力槽減成 4 座，槽和槽之間留 1px 間隔。

v0 覆土式配水池的身分讀不出來：整片草皮梯形土丘，配上兩排灰色通氣塔，在 1x 下像墓園或足球場，看不出是水庫。建議改法：(a) 通氣塔減到 3–4 座，改成帶蘑菇頭通風帽的圓柱，並排在一條混凝土頂部走道上；(b) 土丘頂露出一條混凝土頂板帶和人孔列；(c) 閥室和外露送水管移到土丘側前方明顯的位置，讓它成為視覺主體。v3 地上水池屋頂偏空：加 2–3 條伸縮縫分格、防水層色差，以及屋頂設備（通氣管組、太陽能或空調小件），讓細節有層次。v1 兩座預力槽完全相同：把其中一座縮小或改成平頂，或者加上不同的附屬設備（例如一座有外梯加天線、另一座有頂部通風機），做出結構差異。v2 和 v4 可以接受。
1×1 小站五個變體的結構差異清楚：沉水式濕井加控制盤、乾井泵房加洗滌塔、圓形 FRP 濕井加拖車發電機、三泵機房加吊車、路邊地下式加市政箱。量體有外框，光從左，沒有裁切，夜間只亮燈具。小建議（不擋定稿）：v1 的墨綠發電機仍遮到泵房右半邊的捲門，可以往右後方再挪 2–3px；v4 前緣綠籬加控制箱在 1x 下稍嫌碎，綠籬可以改成一段連續的量體。
身分靠紫色再生水識別帶、MBR 池、UF/RO 廠房和儲槽建立，五個變體結構差異明確（標準、室內拱頂加細高塔、開放膜組加紅磚樓、工業 RO 雨棚加槽車、公園化平台）。小建議（不擋定稿）：v0 前段偏擠，UV 渠被加藥區遮住，可以把加藥區往後挪半格，讓 UV 渠露出來；v4 平台上的樹減少約 1/3，露出採光天窗和通風塔。
五個變體都一眼認得出是污水廠：圓形二沉池、曝氣廊道、消化槽、滴濾池、氧化溝都表現得很清楚，年代和工法的差異明確，夜圖有節制，外框和光向也和 BESS 一致。小建議（不擋定稿）：v1 蛋形消化槽的白色可以壓暗一階，並加深右側陰影，才不會讀成筒倉；v4 氧化溝的轉刷尾流可以改成 2–3 條順流向的短白線。
下凹池體的高度場遮擋做得對。階梯草坡、運動場加看台、濕式常水池、水廣場、雙池自然式，五種佈局差異完整；進出流工、攔污柵、坡道這些配件讓人認得出是滯洪設施。小建議（不擋定稿）：v4 主池草地偏素，可以多加一道低水路或一片濕地水窪；v3 樹穴小叉改成方形樹穴框。全部 fence:false 算合理的公園型例外，要不要統一由業主決定。
植物量體畫法避開了雜點牆問題。分格表面流加觀察塔、自然式、礫石床加豎管、階梯跌水、教育館，五個變體結構不同，而且都認得出是人工濕地。小建議（不擋定稿）：v1 水域和植物帶的邊界還是偏碎，可以合併掉小水塊、邊界平滑一階；v0 各格物種在 1x 下只靠色調區分，香蒲可以加深褐色穗點，和蘆葦的淺色穗區分開。

reviews.overall: 三批共 7 類、35 個變體鍵都已覆寫，也都有定稿接觸表，整體相比舊的平視畫法有明顯進步，風格和新 BESS 一致。5 類判 pass，2 類判 fix：k154 v0 覆土配水池在 1x 下讀成墓園或球場，身分不清楚，而且 v1 兩座槽完全相同、v3 屋頂偏空；k153 只差 v2 通氣小亭沒墊到池頂高度的小修。k157、k158、k156、k159、k160 都通過，細節層次和變體間的結構差異足夠，只有少量擁擠與遮擋的小建議。另外要提醒：這些評估都只看過接觸表，還沒在實際城市截圖裡驗證 1×1 小站（k157）反覆出現時的效果。
